result.rationale: The migration inserts raw values from the removed embeddable_hosts site setting via SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, bypassing the model's before_validation normalization (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`). The new `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host) = uri.host`, so a stored value like 'http://eviltrout.com' will never match referer host 'eviltrout.com'. The old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` stripped the scheme during comparison, so users who stored scheme-prefixed hosts would have working embeds silently break after migration
